component.name: TV Web
component.summary: Watch tv.apple.com in a dedicated window

description.p: TV Web opens the official Apple TV website in its own Fedora GNOME window. It keeps sign-in data in a dedicated local profile and sends non-Apple links to your default browser.
This is an unofficial web client, not an Apple product or a native Apple TV SDK app. Playback quality and features match what tv.apple.com provides to the Linux web engine.
Fix the first-run buttons under Electron’s sandbox.

ul.li: Add a clear first-run guide and remembered window size.
Add Fedora RPM and ARM64 release downloads.
Improve navigation safety, shortcuts, tests, and documentation.
